```{r}
risk_data <- Neuroethics_Judgement %>% 
  filter(!rt <= 250) %>% #before or after the intial cutoff
  filter(!rt >= 9000) %>% 
  group_by(user_id) %>% 
  mutate(Q1 = quantile(rt, .25),
         Q3 = quantile(rt, .75),
         IQR = IQR(rt)) %>% 
  filter(rt > (Q1 - 2*IQR) & rt < (Q3 + 2*IQR)) %>% 
  group_by(user_id) %>%
  # mutate(
  #   risk = scale(risk),
  #   gain = scale(gain)
  # ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
save(risk_data, file = "FINAL_RT_EXCLUDED_DATA_20240417.RData")
```
